title: Agents That Deploy Infrastructure — Hoover Dam
summary: A walkable dam-world above Lake Mead: six zones mapped onto the real Hoover Dam structures, where agent crews take an idea from bench plan to rehearsed provisioning, deployment, domains, configuration and round-the-clock operations.

buildings.name: Plan Gallery
buildings.use: Where ideas become readable build-and-run plans

buildings.name: Drafting Terrace
buildings.use: Open-air sketch tables overlooking the canyon

props: brass telescope aimed at the intake towers

buildings.name: Rehearsal Shed
buildings.use: Dry-run provisioning of compute, storage and networks

buildings.name: Crate Depot
buildings.use: Staged infrastructure parts awaiting steward approval

buildings.name: Release Hall
buildings.use: Builds, releases and rollbacks for deployed applications

buildings.name: Registry Desk
buildings.use: Public desk for domain records and steward decisions

buildings.name: Valve House Config Room
buildings.use: Service settings and wiring, mirroring the real valve house

buildings.name: Secrets Cabinet Annex
buildings.use: Policy and handling for secrets, never held in prompts

buildings.name: Operations Deck
buildings.use: Health, logs, incidents and on-call handoff to people

buildings.name: On-Call Watchtower
buildings.use: Overlooks the dam crest for the human on-call handoff

court.name: The Gauge Court
court.style: Art Deco intake-tower plaza set between the Nevada and Arizona intake towers
court.why_here: The dam's gauges and towers embody operating infrastructure daily; here disputes are read off the dials and settled before the stewards.

quests.title: From Idea to Blueprint
steps: Hear the idea at the Plan Gallery
Sit with Planner to shape a build-and-run plan
Read the Assumption Wall for unstated risks
Carry the approved plan to the Provisioning Yard
Log it in the Rehearsal Floor queue

quests.title: Rehearsal Before the River
steps: Inspect staged crates in the Crate Depot
Watch Provisioner dry-run provisioning
Confirm the awaiting-approval lamp is lit
Hand the rehearsed plan to Deployer at Release Hall
Verify the rollback vault is stocked

quests.title: The Named Address
steps: Fetch the release record from Version Board Room
Ring the brass bell at the Registry Desk
Lay the request before the Domain Steward
Wait on the bench for the steward decision
Record the outcome in the ledgers

quests.title: Wired Without Secrets
steps: Carry the domain record to the Valve House Config Room
Match settings against the Wiring Diagram Wall
Check the secrets cabinet stays locked
Have Configurator sign the policy alcove ledger

quests.title: The Night On-Call
steps: Signal configuration complete from the Handoff Bench
Climb to the Gauge Hall on the Operations Deck
Join Operator on the incident bridge when the klaxon sounds
Draft the incident note for the human on-call
Place the red hotline call for the steward handoff
